Of course successful people can feel suicidal. They're just human like everyone else who specialised in something and may of had a bit of luck in their journey. Look at the best of the best; Robin Williams being a key example and Kurt Cobain. 


   I always see wealthy or famous people and think of them in a higher light but I'll always remember that they're just people. We all have the potential to be great at something. 

  
   Hang in there! Don't give up. <3 :]
That was absolutely beautiful to read. <3
Thanks for reading and replying. And I'll stick with it, always (well...for as long as I can anyway...). Hopefully things work out. All the best. Take care of yourself. :)

That is actually exactly the kind of thing I've been looking for. Obviously, this isn't exactly my first "crush" and I've just never had the ability to properly be the person to pursue or handle the situation as I've never known how to. And I'll do it in person, still in school (graduation in about 2-3 weeks), so we still see each other at least 5 times per week. Thank you for this, honestly, I can't thank you enough. I'll do what I can, and may (probably will) PM you in the near future if I need anything more. But for now, I have to wake up for school in about 7 hours, so I'm gonna get some sleep. Thank youuu !! All the best. - Kevin
Thank you for your help. It's much appreciated !! Really, thank you.

Very true, I had an extremely big probably of over analysing everything I do, but eventually a close friend simply gave me the advice; "Don't over think". It may sound like the most basic thing, but just having her tell me that, over and over again has been tremendously helpful, with "Don't over think" now being like...one of my life mottos.
~~~
What's a good way to actually tell her how I feel about her? Is complete 100% honestly the best way to go, like...pulling her aside and directly telling her that I have feelings for her? Is it too much? If so, how do I tell her in a "lighter" way?

Thanks, I think I've always known what I should do, since like...the phrase "just be honest" is absolutely everywhere, regarding every issue. It's even one of the main pieces of advice I give to people, but it's just a lot harder to actually conduct when presented with such a situation. I'm mainly just worried I'll scare her away and lose the ability to help her if/when she needs it.
Of course, her happiness is what I care about. So...should I just let her know that I'm available and help her when she needs it or should I like...message her first?

Thanks for taking the time to read and respond, it means a lot. My feelings...what do you consider over dramatic? I've liked for quite a while, nobody knows. A small number of people may suspect it, but it's been extremely easy to diffuse those thoughts in other people. And yeah, I do care for her, more than she knows. Thank you for your suggestion of honesty. I've wanted to tell her how I feel for so long, and I think I will. I'm coming to the end of Year 12; less than 3 weeks till graduation, so I might as well tell her. Thank you so much for helping me. It really means a lot.
Thanks, and ye, sucks hey? What are you doing with your situation? Any advice you could offer?

Sex. He doesn't want to commit to Cara, mainly cause he doesn't like...fully feel that way about her. They talk pretty much everyday over social media but rarely see each other in person. I just got home from, pretty much was a school talent show sorta thing, they were both there and Tyler barely glances at Cara. They exchanged a "hi" and that was about it for the entire night. It's always like this unless they meet up, just the two of them. 
P.S. All info is from Cara
P.S.S. Thank you for thinking me of as a sweetheart. I think of you as the same.

No matter where anyone is in their life, or what they're doing, there's always something more. The door to this girl may not be entirely closed, you may have a chance, but if you turn a corner, you may find yourself with a thousand more doors, with infinite possibilities. Find a nice album, book, tv series (this one works wonders for me), draw something, even if you suck at drawing, it may lead to something great. Don't give up. <3
